name: print-social-fish-and-left-right-poster-pair-in-blue-and-yellow
title: Two blue posters: repeated fish silhouettes around a giant FISH, and yellow arrows pointing LEFT and RIGHT
whatItIs: On black, two portrait posters. The left is sky blue with two blocks of nine navy fish silhouettes and a huge white 'FISH' between small story paragraphs. The right is deep blue with 'LEFT' and 'RIGHT' in white and two rows of yellow chevrons pointing opposite ways over lines.
whatItMeans: Bold and witty; shapes and words say the same thing at monumental scale.
techniques: Tile a simple silhouette into a block pattern.
Set one huge white word across the centre.
Use chevrons on a line as directional graphics.
Keep small two-column body text as texture.

vocabulary.definition: A repeat of a solid shape.
A single word set at poster scale.
